turns.input: *He asks Captain Doran Hale who they think he is and where he comes from.*
turns.draft:
Across the cobbles of Heartstone Square, Captain Doran Hale held Nicco’s gaze with a measured, appraising look. The guard captain stood tall in his practical heavy armor, his scarred features settling into a calm, neutral line as he took in Nicco's frame.

"I don't know you," Hale said, his voice level and steady over the moderate daytime stir of the street. "You're not one of the faces I usually see around this quarter, and I haven't taken your name. If I had to guess from looking at you, you haven't spent your life turning over earth or breaking stone in the yards, but beyond that, Calderan brings in all sorts."

He rested a gauntleted hand near the hilt of his longsword, not drawing it, merely resting in stance. "Where you come from and who you claim to be are things you'd have to tell me yourself, unless you've given the watch a reason to ask."
